in_sanskrit.name: अमला
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is free from impurities and has the quality of being pure.

in_hindi.name: अमला
in_hindi.long_meaning: She who is free from impurities and has a radiant and pure appearance.

in_tamil.name: அமலா
in_tamil.long_meaning: She who is pure, free from impurities and is in a state of absolute purity.

in_telugu.name: అమల
in_telugu.long_meaning: She who is pure, free from impurities and has the quality of being a pooja item.

in_marathi.name: Amala
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Amala means 'nectar' in Sanskrit and 'blue' in Tamil. It symbolizes purity, grace, and the beauty of nature.

in_bengali.name: Amala
in_bengali.long_meaning: Amala একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Amala means 'nectar' in Sanskrit and 'blue' in Tamil. It symbolizes purity, grace, and the beauty of nature.
